title: Creamy Ukrainian Wild Rice Bowl
description: A hearty and comforting dish that combines the nutty flavor of wild rice with the creaminess of a wine-infused sauce.
instructions: 1. In a medium saucepan, heat 1 tablespoon of butter over medium heat.
2. Add the wild rice and cook for 2-3 minutes, stirring constantly.
3. Add 2 cups of water to the saucepan and bring to a boil.
4. Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 40-45 minutes, or until the rice is tender.
5. In a large skillet, heat 1 tablespoon of butter over medium heat.
6. Add the mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown, about 5 minutes.
7. Add the wine to the skillet and cook until the liquid has almost completely evaporated, stirring occasionally.
8. Stir in the milk, sour cream, and fresh dill.
9. To assemble the bowls, divide the cooked wild rice between two bowls.
10. Top each bowl with the mushroom mixture and serve immediately.
